title: Popoitto Hebereke
overview:
Head-to-head battles are hot!!!

Popoitto Hebereke is a cheerful falling-block puzzle game starring Hebereke and friends. Popoons drop in pairs - line up four of the same color vertically or horizontally to clear them, along with any matching Poroporos. Clear every Poroporo on the field to finish the stage. Watch your placement: a Popoon that catches on a Poroporo and hangs over the side stays put instead of dropping.

- One player: Hebereke journeys through eight stages, and each character he beats joins him
- Two players: best-of-three battles where chain reactions send extra Popoons to your opponent
- Options for difficulty, clearing rules and diagonal moves
- Memory backup

対戦が熱い！！！
